headline: Baxter (BAX) Stock May Be 19% Undervalued On Cash Flow
summary: Baxter International stock has delivered a steep decline of about 64.6% over the past five years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares may now be trading below an estimate of intrinsic value. With both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples screening the stock as undervalued, investors are weighing whether this signals an opportunity or a value trap.
